# Visual Studio Code Interface Description

## Window Header

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" on the left and "Welcome - my_flask_app - Visual Studio Code" in the center.
- **System Information**: Date and time "Oct 23 01:12" displayed in the center of the title bar.
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the right side of the title bar, including:
  - Network/Connection icon
  - Sound/volume control icon
  - Power button icon
- **Window Control Buttons**: On the far right of the title bar, including:
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)

## Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: From left to right: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help.
- **Active Menu**: The "File" menu is currently active, with its dropdown visible.

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Explorer Icon**: Folders icon, currently active.
- **Search Icon**: Magnifying glass icon.
- **Source Control Icon**: Branch icon.
- **Debug Icon**: Bug icon.
- **Extensions Icon**: Square grid icon.
- **Application Icons**: A vertical dock on the left side of the screen, including:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash

## Main Workspace

### Explorer Panel

- **Panel Title**: "EXPLORER"
- **Folder Structure**:
  - "MY_FLASK_APP" (expanded)
  - "OUTLINE"
  - "TIMELINE"

### Welcome Page

- **Title**: "Visual Studio Code" with subtitle "Editing evolved"
- **Start Section**:
  - "New File..." with a plus icon
  - "Open File..." with an open folder icon
  - "Open Folder..." with a folder icon
  - "Connect to..." with a cloud icon
- **Recent Section**:
  - Text: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - "Get Started with VS Code" with a star icon and description: "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding"
  - "Learn the Fundamentals" with a lightbulb icon

### New File Dialog

- **Title**: "New File..."
- **Input Field**: "Select File Type or Enter File Name..."
- **File Type Options**:
  - "Text File" (selected, with "Built-In" label)
  - "Jupyter Notebook" (with ".ipynb Support" label)
- **Keyboard Shortcut**: "Ctrl + N" displayed next to "File" with a gear icon

## Bottom Panel

### Activity Bar (Bottom)

- **Panel Tabs**: From left to right: PROBLEMS, OUTPUT, DEBUG CONSOLE, TERMINAL, PORTS
- **Active Tab**: "TERMINAL"

### Terminal Panel

- **Terminal Content**:
  - Command prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine:~/Downloads/my_flask_app$"
  - Cursor at the end of the prompt
- **Terminal Controls**:
  - Plus icon for adding new terminal
  - Three dots for more options
  - Up arrow for history
  - X for closing terminal

### Terminal Tabs

- **Tab 1**: "bash" (active)
- **Tab 2**: "bash"
- **Tab 3**: "bash"

## Status Bar

- **Left Side**:
  - User icon
  - Settings gear icon with a notification badge (number 1)
- **Center**:
  - Status indicators: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 tasks
- **Right Side**:
  - Git branch indicator
  - File type indicator
  - Language indicator
  - Search indicator

## Additional UI Elements

- **Check Box**: "Show welcome page on startup" with a checked checkbox
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons in the top-right corner
- **System Menu**: "Activities" button in the top-left corner

## Visual Elements

- **Color Scheme**: Dark theme with white and light gray text
- **Icons**: All icons are monochromatic and consistent with the dark theme
- **Typography**: Clean, sans-serif font for all text elements
- **Spacing**: Consistent padding and margins throughout the interface

## Layout

- **Top**: Menu bar and window controls
- **Left**: Activity bar and Explorer panel
- **Center**: Main workspace with Welcome page
- **Bottom**: Activity bar and Terminal panel
- **Right**:
